title: Spectro-kinetic modelling of photocatalytic oxidation of heterocyclic compounds in a continuous-flow packed bed reactor

Plasmonic photocatalysis in a continuous-flow reactor generates e⁻/h⁺ and ROS. EPR enables time-resolved detection of intermediates coupling mechanistic and kinetic frameworks within a spectro-kinetic model for photocatalytic process development.
